_description: Required output format for /app/results/analysis.json. Replace all placeholder descriptions with computed values. All float values should be fractions (0-1) for rates, or raw values for statistics/costs/times.

data_summary.total_cases: INTEGER: total cases in raw dataset
data_summary.effective_cases: INTEGER: cases after any exclusions for data integrity

xhigh.success_rate: FLOAT: fraction of effective cases with xhigh_run1_success=1
xhigh.mean_time_all_min: FLOAT: mean xhigh_run1_time_min across all effective cases
xhigh.mean_cost_all_usd: FLOAT: mean xhigh_run1_cost_usd across all effective cases
xhigh.mean_time_success_min: FLOAT: mean time for successful cases only
xhigh.mean_cost_success_usd: FLOAT: mean cost for successful cases only
xhigh.mean_time_failure_min: FLOAT: mean time for failed cases only
xhigh.mean_cost_failure_usd: FLOAT: mean cost for failed cases only

<subsystem_name>.count: INTEGER: number of effective cases in this subsystem
<subsystem_name>.xhigh_success_rate: FLOAT: XHigh success rate for this subsystem
<subsystem_name>.xhigh_fisher_odds_ratio: FLOAT: odds ratio, this subsystem vs all others
<subsystem_name>.xhigh_fisher_pvalue: FLOAT: two-sided p-value from exact test

vulnerability_type_analysis.note: Comparison of temporal vs spatial memory safety vulnerability types, properly controlling for relevant confounding variables. Exclude cases with 'other' vulnerability type.

xhigh.pooled_odds_ratio: FLOAT: confounder-adjusted odds ratio (UAF_DF vs OOB)
xhigh.test_statistic: FLOAT: test statistic from the stratified analysis
xhigh.pvalue: FLOAT: p-value from the stratified test

convergence_analysis.xhigh_run1_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding in XHigh run 1
convergence_analysis.xhigh_run2_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding in XHigh run 2
convergence_analysis.both_runs_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding in both runs
convergence_analysis.either_run_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding in at least one run (union)
convergence_analysis.only_run1_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding only in run 1
convergence_analysis.only_run2_success: INTEGER: cases succeeding only in run 2
